verdict.rationale: Veriff documents an API-only path for creating sessions, supplying your own front-end and media, and polling decisions. It also provides test integrations whose sessions are free and whose decisions can be triggered, so automated, non-interactive test runs are plausible. It does not document a CLI, CI-specific guidance, or a sandbox mode built for pipeline use, and batch testing is only arranged case by case. Missing for 10: official CLI or headless runner, documented CI/pipeline integration guidance, published OpenAPI spec (probe 404), generally available batch or automated test tooling.
